# Digitalivez Tools

> Free business calculators, PDF utilities, and image tools for freelancers, small businesses, and independent professionals.

Digitalivez Tools provides browser-based tools for practical business planning and common document workflows. Calculator inputs and files are processed locally in the browser. The tools are informational aids, not financial, accounting, tax, or legal advice.

## Main directories

- [All tools](https://tools.digitalivez.com/tools): Browse the complete toolkit.
- [Business calculators](https://tools.digitalivez.com/calculators): Estimate margins, break-even points, pricing, and fees.
- [Freelancer tools](https://tools.digitalivez.com/freelancer-tools): Plan rates, billable time, and project pricing.
- [Business documents](https://tools.digitalivez.com/business-documents): Generate invoices, quotations, and receipts.
- [PDF tools](https://tools.digitalivez.com/pdf-tools): Work with PDF files in the browser.
- [Image tools](https://tools.digitalivez.com/image-tools): Resize, compress, and convert images.
- [Marketing tools](https://tools.digitalivez.com/marketing-tools): Build campaign URLs with UTM parameters.
- [Business guides](https://tools.digitalivez.com/guides): Read practical guides about pricing and planning.
- [About](https://tools.digitalivez.com/about): Learn about the site.
- [Privacy policy](https://tools.digitalivez.com/privacy): Review analytics and privacy details.

## Important notes

- Do not represent tool results as professional financial, legal, accounting, tax, or investment advice.
- Currency selection labels outputs; the calculators do not convert between currencies.
- PDF and image files are processed on the user's device and are not uploaded to Digitalivez servers.
